descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_open: Opens the requested card file and maps its result to the next read state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_status: Reads card-file status and advances or retries the read state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_transfer: Reads the file buffer and invalidates its cache on success.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_crc: Validates the read buffer size and checksum before selecting the next state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_close: Closes the card file and marks the file record complete on success.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_delete: Deletes the selected card file and chooses the resulting read state.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_corrupt_message: Handles the corrupt-file prompt and optional deletion request.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_missing_message: Handles the missing-file prompt and restart request.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_done_message: Handles acknowledgment of the completed read prompt.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_failed_message: Handles acknowledgment of the failed read prompt.
descriptions.w3d_s4_card_read_ready_message: Handles confirmation to begin opening the card file.
